title: agent-system project configuration
description: Drop this at <repo>/.claude/agent-system.json to opt a project into the agent-system. Absence of this file means the project is not opted in: hooks stay silent and the commit guard never fires.

project.description: Short project name, used as the event-log key and the dashboard title.

worktreesDir.description: Directory holding the fixed worktrees. Lane numbers are the 1-based alphabetical position of each subdirectory — stable across worktree add/remove. Supports ~ expansion.

basePort.description: Dev-server port prefix, purely informational. Lane N is shown as serving on `${basePort}${N}` (basePort 300 -> lane 2 is 3002).

commands.description: Project commands. /review runs the gates once at the end; the reviewer never runs them. A command left null is a gate that is skipped, and /review says so.

pattern.description: Regex whose first all-digits capture group is the issue number. Default: ^[a-z]+/(\d+)-

prefixes.description: Branch prefix -> issue label. null means no label.

base.description: Base branch new work branches off, and the reference for ahead/behind and free-lane detection. Default "main".

commitGuard.description: When false, `git commit` is never blocked for lack of review. Default true.

largeDiffThreshold.description: Changed-line count past which the guard warns that review quality degrades. Default 400.

excludePattern.description: Regex of generated/vendored paths to drop from review scope. Reviewing them is pure noise.

domainAxes.description: Project-specific judgment axes for the reviewer. This is the field that makes the reviewer worth running: a generic 'best practices' reviewer finds nothing useful.

expertiseDoc.description: Repo-relative path to the project's testing conventions doc, read by the test agent before writing anything.

challengeSpec.description: Run the spec-challenger agent against the draft spec before creating the issue. Default true.

dev.description: Per-lane dev services. Every project declares its own: no two stacks start the same way, and one repo can have several services (e.g. a React client and a Python API) with different commands, directories and port series.

name.description: Short id, used in `lanes dev` output, log filenames and `lanes logs <n> <name>`.

cwd.description: Directory relative to the worktree root. Default "." — set it for monorepo services.

portBase.description: Port prefix for this service. Lane N gets `${portBase}${N}` (400 -> lane 2 is 4002). Defaults to the top-level basePort.

url.description: Optional URL shown when the service starts. Same placeholders.
